ud4.4:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
ud4.4:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca Sāriputto āyasmā ca Mahāmoggallāno Kapotakandarāyaṃ viharanti.
ud4.4:1.4: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Sāriputto juṇhāya rattiyā navoropitehi kesehi abbhokāse nisinno hoti aññataraṃ samādhiṃ samāpajjitvā.
ud4.4:2.1: tena kho pana samayena dve yakkhā sahāyakā uttarāya disāya dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ gacchanti kena cid eva karaṇīyena.
ud4.4:2.2: addasaṃsu kho te yakkhā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ juṇhāya rattiyā navoropitehi kesehi abbhokāse nisinnaṃ,
ud4.4:2.3: disvā eko yakkho dutiyaṃ yakkhaṃ etad avoca:
ud4.4:2.4: paṭibhāti maṃ samma imassa samaṇassa sīse pahāraṃ dātun ti.
ud4.4:2.5: evaṃ vutte so yakkho tam yakkhaṃ etad avoca:
ud4.4:2.7: uḷāro so samma samaṇo mahiddhiko mahānubhāvo 'ti.
ud4.4:3.1: dutiyam pi kho so yakkho taṃ yakkhaṃ etad avoca:
ud4.4:3.2: paṭibhāti maṃ samma imassa samaṇassa sīse pahāraṃ dātun ti.
ud4.4:3.3: dutiyam pi kho so yakkho taṃ yakkhaṃ etad avoca:
ud4.4:3.6: tatiyam pi kho so yakkho taṃ yakkhaṃ etad avoca:
ud4.4:3.8: tatiyam pi kho so yakkho taṃ yakkhaṃ etad avoca:
ud4.4:4.1: atha kho so yakkho taṃ yakkhaṃ anādiyitvā āyasmato Sāriputtatherassa sīse pahāraṃ adāsi.
ud4.4:4.2: api tena pahāreṇa sattaratanaṃ vā aḍḍhaṭṭharatanaṃ vā nāgaṃ osādeyya mahantaṃ vā pabbatakūṭaṃ padāleyya.
ud4.4:4.3: atha ca pana so yakkho ḍayhāmi ḍayhāmī 'ti vatvā tatth' eva mahānirayaṃ avaṭṭhāsi .
ud4.4:5.1: addasā kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena tena yakkhena āyasmato Sāriputtassa sīse pahāraṃ dīyamānaṃ,
ud4.4:5.2: disvāna yena āyasmā Sāriputto ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ etad avoca:
ud4.4:5.3: kacci te āvuso khamanīyaṃ kacci yāpanīyaṃ kacci na kiñci dukkhan ti.
ud4.4:5.4: khamanīyaṃ me āvuso Moggallāna yāpanīyaṃ me āvuso Moggallāna,
ud4.4:5.5: api ca me sīse thokam dukkhan ti.
ud4.4:6.1: acchariyaṃ āvuso Sāriputta, abbhutaṃ āvuso Sāriputta,
ud4.4:6.2: yaṃ tvaṃ mahiddhiko āyasmā Sāriputto mahānubhāvo.
ud4.4:6.3: idha te āvuso Sāriputta aññataro yakkho sīse pahāraṃ adāsi,
ud4.4:6.4: tāva mahāpahāro ahosi. api tena pahārena sattaratanaṃ . . . padāleyyā 'ti. atha ca pan' āyasmā Sāriputto evam āha:
ud4.4:6.5: khamanīyaṃ me āvuso Moggallāna, yāpanīyaṃ me āvuso Moggallāna,
ud4.4:6.6: api ca me sīse thokaṃ dukkhan ti.
ud4.4:7.1: acchariyaṃ āvuso Moggallāna, abbhutaṃ āvuso Moggallāna,
ud4.4:7.2: yāva mahiddhiko āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno mahānubhāvo, yatra hi nāma yakkham pi passissati;
ud4.4:7.3: mayaṃ pan' etarahi Paṃsupisācakam pi na passāmā 'ti.
ud4.4:8.1: assosi kho bhagavā dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya atikkantamānusikāya tesaṃ ubhinnaṃ mahānāgānaṃ imaṃ evarūpaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ.
ud4.4:9.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
